scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && uv venv --python 3.14 apps/api/.venv && uv pip install -p apps/api/.venv -r apps/api/requirements.txt -r apps/api/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && cd apps/api && .venv/bin/ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web test && cd apps/api && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
